name: Budibase
description: Budibase is a low-code platform for building internal tools such as forms, portals, admin panels and approval apps. Apps run on its built-in database or on PostgreSQL, MySQL, REST APIs and Google Sheets, with automations triggered by events, schedules or webhooks.

notes.text: There is no default account: create the admin on the setup page right after the install. Until then anyone who reaches port 80 can claim it.
Without a license key Budibase runs the free self-hosted plan: one workspace, unlimited users and rows, no user groups and no custom AI providers.
AI agents and custom AI providers also need your own LiteLLM proxy: set LITELLM_URL and LITELLM_MASTER_KEY in /opt/budibase_data/.env and run systemctl restart budibase-server.
